archetypes.name: dyn-step5-durable-bail
archetypes.rationale: Relocated Step 5 durable-stall authority has subtle override semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed Step 5 Durable Bail reference and its SKILL.md pointer. Verify that terminal Step 5 MAV/coder stalls still route through the main-agent handoff paragraph, record timing once, force STALL_TRACKING=true, and never persist raw non-lint-fix stall reasons. Check the structure harness pins cover the relocated authority without constraining the normal stall branch seeder. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
